decisions.reason: Job has not spoken since 31:40, yet the LORD is said to "answer". The verb is used for taking up a speech, as in 3:2, where Job "answered" though no one had spoken. The words that follow close the first speech with a challenge to Job.

decisions.choice: a faultfinder: one who finds fault, a critic
decisions.reason: The word occurs only here. Taken as a noun from the verb "to correct, discipline", it means one who corrects or criticizes; this fits the parallel "one who reproves God". Some read it as a verb: "Will the one who contends with the Almighty correct him?" Either way the question is aimed at Job, who has charged God with wrong.

decisions.choice: contend, reprove: words of the law court
decisions.reason: The verb "contend" (riv) means to bring a lawsuit (9:3; 13:8), and "one who reproves" (mokhiach) is one who argues a case or decides it (9:33; 13:3). Job wanted a hearing with God (13:3; 31:35); God now calls on him to make his case.

decisions.choice: answer it: answer the questions just asked
decisions.reason: "It" is the whole challenge of chapters 38-39. Job, who wanted to question God, must now answer God's questions. Shaddai is "the Almighty" (see 5:17); 'Eloah is "God".

decisions.choice: God All-Powerful; still argue with him
decisions.reason: Readable says "God All-Powerful" for Shaddai, as everywhere in this translation, and says plainly that the faultfinder argues with God.

decisions.choice: God speaks to Job in 해라체 with 너 and names himself 나 without -시- (38-41); Job answers God in 합쇼체 with 주님 and 저 (40:4-5; 42:2-6)
decisions.reason: The terms for Job settle these levels: God's speeches from the storm are a rebuke, as God's speeches in the prophets, and Job speaks to God as the psalmists do.

decisions.choice: I am small: light, of little weight
decisions.reason: The verb means to be light, of no weight, the opposite of being "heavy" in honor. Job does not confess a sin here; he admits that he is too small to answer God.

decisions.choice: hand to mouth: a sign of silence
decisions.reason: Putting the hand over the mouth means keeping silent in awe or shame (21:5; 29:9; Micah 7:16). Job had once silenced others in this way (29:9); now he is silenced.

decisions.choice: no word for "look" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew opens with a word that calls attention (hen). Literal keeps it as "Look"; Balanced and Readable let the sentence carry the stress without it.

decisions.choice: Job to God: "Chúa" for "you" and "con" for himself
decisions.reason: As the Psalms' laments. Here Job is humbled, and "con" fits; "tôi" stays the alternative for his bitter speeches earlier in the book.

decisions.choice: Job answers the LORD with "tu" ("te responderei")
decisions.reason: Job addresses God with "tu" here and in 42:2-6, as he has in his prayers through the book (9:28; 30:20) and as everyone in the Bible speaks to God (docs/portuguese-style.md section 4); the humility is in what he says.

es.R: Prepárate como un luchador. \q Yo haré las preguntas, \q y tú {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} responderás.

fr.L: Ceins donc tes reins comme un homme ; \q je t’interrogerai, \q et toi, fais-le-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} savoir.
fr.B: Prépare-toi comme un homme ; \q je vais te questionner, \q et tu {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} donneras les réponses.
fr.R: Prépare-toi comme un combattant. \q Je vais poser les questions, \q et tu {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} donneras les réponses.

sw.L: Funga basi viuno vyako kama mwanamume; \q mimi nitakuuliza, \q nawe unijulishe [jibu].
sw.B: Jiandae kama mwanamume; \q nitakuuliza maswali, \q nawe utanipa majibu.
sw.R: Jiweke tayari kama mpiganaji. \q Mimi nitauliza maswali, \q nawe utanipa majibu.

vi.L: Hãy thắt lưng ngươi như một người nam; \q Ta sẽ hỏi ngươi, \q và ngươi hãy cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} biết.
vi.B: Hãy chuẩn bị tinh thần như một trang nam tử; \q Ta sẽ chất vấn ngươi, \q và ngươi sẽ trả lời cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Hãy sẵn sàng như một chiến binh. \q Ta sẽ đặt câu hỏi, \q còn ngươi sẽ trả lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: 이제 사내답게 네 허리를 동여라. \q 내가 너에게 묻겠으니, \q 너는 나에게 알게 하여라.
ko.B: 사내답게 단단히 준비하여라. \q 내가 너에게 묻겠다. \q 너는 나에게 대답해 보아라.
ko.R: 용사처럼 마음을 단단히 먹어라. \q 이제 내가 묻겠다. \q 너는 나에게 대답해 보아라.

pt.L: Cinge agora os teus lombos como homem; \q eu te perguntarei, \q e tu {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} farás saber.
pt.B: Prepara-te como um homem forte; \q eu vou te interrogar, \q e tu {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} darás as respostas.
pt.R: Prepara-te como um lutador. \q Eu vou fazer as perguntas, \q e tu vais {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} dar as respostas.

decisions.choice: the same words as 38:3
decisions.reason: God repeats the challenge of 38:3 word for word, and the wording here follows 38:3. Job has said he will not answer (40:5), but God calls him to answer once more.

decisions.choice: gird up your loins: get ready for action or for a contest
decisions.reason: A man tucked his long robe into his belt to run, work or fight (1 Kings 18:46). Here it means to get ready for a hard contest.

decisions.choice: a man: a strong man, a fighter
decisions.reason: The word (gever) stresses strength and courage (3:3; 38:3). God speaks to Job as to a fighter ready for a match; the word does not set men against women here.

decisions.choice: Brace yourself (B); Get ready (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the picture (m2), which Literal keeps.

source.text: הַ֭אַף תָּפֵ֣ר מִשְׁפָּטִ֑י תַּ֝רְשִׁיעֵ֗נִי לְמַ֣עַן תִּצְדָּֽק׃

records.literal_gloss: ? Will you even annul my justice? Will you condemn me so that you may be in the right?

en.L: Will you even annul {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} justice? \q Will you condemn {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} so that you may be in the right?
en.B: Would you really set aside {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} justice? \q Would you condemn {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to prove that you are right?
en.R: Would you really say that I am not just? \q Would you blame {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} just so you can say you are right?

es.L: ¿Acaso anularás {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} justicia? \q ¿Acaso {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} condenarás para que tú seas justificado?
es.B: ¿De verdad dejarías sin efecto {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} justicia? \q ¿Acaso {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} declararías culpable para probar que tienes razón?
es.R: ¿De verdad dirías que yo no soy justo? \q ¿Acaso {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} culparías solo para decir que tú tienes razón?

fr.L: Iras-tu jusqu’à annuler {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} justice ? \q Vas-tu {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} condamner pour être, toi, dans ton droit ?
fr.B: Voudrais-tu vraiment mettre de côté {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} justice ? \q Voudrais-tu {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} condamner pour prouver que tu as raison ?
fr.R: Oserais-tu vraiment dire que je ne suis pas juste ? \q Voudrais-tu {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} blâmer rien que pour pouvoir dire que tu as raison ?

sw.L: Je, hata utaibatilisha haki {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}? \q Je, utanihukumu kuwa na hatia ili wewe uonekane mwenye haki?
sw.B: Je, kweli ungeiweka kando haki {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}? \q Je, ungenihukumu ili kuthibitisha kwamba wewe uko sahihi?
sw.R: Je, kweli ungesema kwamba mimi si mwenye haki? \q Je, ungenilaumu ili tu useme kwamba wewe uko sahihi?

vi.L: Ngươi lại muốn hủy bỏ công lý của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sao? \q Ngươi muốn kết án {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} để ngươi được xem là công chính sao?
vi.B: Ngươi thật muốn gạt bỏ công lý của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sao? \q Ngươi muốn kết tội {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} để chứng tỏ mình đúng sao?
vi.R: Ngươi thật dám nói rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không công bằng sao? \q Ngươi muốn đổ lỗi cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chỉ để nói rằng mình đúng sao?

ko.L: 네가 정말 나의 공의를 깨뜨리겠느냐? \q 네가 의롭게 되려고 나를 정죄하겠느냐?
ko.B: 네가 정말로 나의 공의를 무시하려느냐? \q 네가 옳다는 것을 내세우려고 나를 죄 있다고 하겠느냐?
ko.R: 너는 정말 내가 공정하지 않다고 말하겠느냐? \q 네가 옳다고 말하려고 나를 탓하겠느냐?

pt.L: Vais mesmo anular a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} justiça? \q Vais {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} condenar para que tenhas razão?
pt.B: Vais mesmo pôr de lado a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} justiça? \q Vais {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} condenar para provar que tens razão?
pt.R: Vais mesmo dizer que eu não sou justo? \q Vais {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} culpar só para poder dizer que estás certo?

decisions.choice: annul my justice: make void my just rule
decisions.reason: The verb means to break or make void, as one breaks a covenant (5:12; 15:4). "My justice" (mishpat) is God's just rule of the world, which Job has questioned (19:7; 27:2).

decisions.choice: condemn ... be in the right: words of the law court
decisions.reason: To condemn is to declare guilty; to be in the right is to win the case (9:2, 20). God asks whether Job must make God guilty in order to be found innocent himself. God does not say Job is guilty of the sins the friends charged him with; he challenges Job's charge against God.

decisions.choice: say that I am not just
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what Job's charge amounts to (m1).

decisions.choice: tenhas razão (L), tens razão (B)
decisions.reason: The verb is the law-court word Portuguese renders "ter razão" from 9:2 on (m2): God names the case Job has been trying to win.

source.text: וְאִם־זְר֖וֹעַ כָּאֵ֥ל׀לָ֑ךְ וּ֝בְק֗וֹל כָּמֹ֥הוּ תַרְעֵֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And is an arm like God's yours? And with a voice like his will you thunder?

en.L: Or do you have an arm like God, \q and can you thunder with a voice like {{deity_pronoun:his|His}}?
en.B: Do you have an arm like God's? \q Can you thunder with a voice like {{deity_pronoun:his|His}}?
en.R: Are you as strong as God? \q Can your voice thunder like {{deity_pronoun:his|His}}?

es.L: ¿O tienes tú un brazo como Dios, \q y puedes tronar con una voz como la {{deity_pronoun:suya|Suya}}?
es.B: ¿Tienes un brazo como el de Dios? \q ¿Puedes tronar con una voz como la {{deity_pronoun:suya|Suya}}?
es.R: ¿Eres tan fuerte como Dios? \q ¿Puede tu voz tronar como la {{deity_pronoun:suya|Suya}}?

fr.L: Ou bien as-tu un bras comme Dieu, \q et peux-tu tonner d’une voix comme la {{deity_pronoun:sienne|Sienne}} ?
fr.B: As-tu un bras comme celui de Dieu ? \q Peux-tu tonner d’une voix comme la {{deity_pronoun:sienne|Sienne}} ?
fr.R: Es-tu aussi fort que Dieu ? \q Ta voix peut-elle gronder comme la {{deity_pronoun:sienne|Sienne}} ?

sw.L: Au je, una mkono kama Mungu, \q na je, waweza kunguruma kwa sauti kama {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}?
sw.B: Je, una mkono kama wa Mungu? \q Je, waweza kunguruma kwa sauti kama {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}?
sw.R: Je, una nguvu kama Mungu? \q Je, sauti yako inaweza kunguruma kama {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}?

vi.L: Hay ngươi có cánh tay như Đức Chúa Trời, \q và ngươi có thể cất tiếng sấm như tiếng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chăng?
vi.B: Ngươi có cánh tay như của Đức Chúa Trời không? \q Ngươi có thể cất tiếng rền như sấm giống {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không?
vi.R: Ngươi có mạnh như Đức Chúa Trời không? \q Giọng ngươi có rền vang như sấm giống tiếng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không?

ko.L: 아니면 너에게 하나님과 같은 팔이 있느냐? \q 그와 같은 목소리로 천둥을 울릴 수 있느냐?
ko.B: 너에게 하나님 같은 팔이 있느냐? \q 그처럼 우렁찬 소리로 천둥을 울리겠느냐?
ko.R: 네가 하나님만큼 강하냐? \q 네 목소리가 그처럼 천둥같이 울리느냐?

pt.L: Ou tens um braço como Deus, \q e podes trovejar com uma voz como a {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}?
pt.B: Tens um braço como o de Deus? \q Podes trovejar com uma voz como a {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}?
pt.R: És tão forte como Deus? \q A tua voz pode trovejar como a {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}?

decisions.choice: an arm: power
decisions.reason: The arm stands for strength to act, often God's power to save or judge (Exodus 6:6; Deuteronomy 5:15).

decisions.choice: thunder: God's voice
decisions.reason: Thunder is pictured as God's voice (37:4-5; Psalm 29:3).

decisions.choice: God speaks of himself as "God" and "him"
decisions.reason: As in 39:17, God speaks of himself in the third person ('El, "God").

decisions.choice: as strong as God
decisions.reason: Readable says what the arm stands for (m1).

decisions.choice: "그" for "him", without -시-, as God speaks of himself in the third person ("God")
decisions.reason: The Hebrew keeps the third person (m3), and Korean keeps it; since the speaker is God himself, he takes no honorific, as God names himself without -시- in his speeches (also 40:19).

source.text: עֲדֵ֥ה נָ֣א גָֽא֣וֹןוָגֹ֑בַהּ וְה֖וֹד וְהָדָ֣ר תִּלְבָּֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: Adorn yourself, please, [with] majesty and loftiness, and [with] splendor and glory clothe yourself.

en.L: Adorn yourself, please, with majesty and loftiness, \q and clothe yourself with splendor and glory.
en.B: Then put on majesty and dignity; \q clothe yourself with splendor and glory.
en.R: Then dress yourself in majesty and greatness, \q and put on glory and splendor like royal robes.

es.L: Adórnate ahora de majestad y de altura, \q y vístete de esplendor y de gloria.
es.B: Revístete, pues, de majestad y dignidad; \q vístete de esplendor y de gloria.
es.R: Vístete entonces de majestad y grandeza, \q y ponte la gloria y el esplendor como ropa de rey.

fr.L: Pare-toi donc de majesté et de grandeur, \q et revêts-toi de splendeur et de gloire.
fr.B: Alors, revêts-toi de majesté et de dignité ; \q habille-toi de splendeur et de gloire.
fr.R: Alors habille-toi de majesté et de grandeur, \q et mets la gloire et la splendeur comme un vêtement royal.

sw.L: Jipambe sasa kwa enzi na ukuu, \q nawe ujivike fahari na utukufu.
sw.B: Basi jivike enzi na heshima; \q jivike fahari na utukufu.
sw.R: Basi jivike enzi na ukuu, \q na uvae utukufu na fahari kama mavazi ya kifalme.

vi.L: Nào, hãy trang sức bằng uy nghi và cao trọng, \q và mặc lấy vẻ huy hoàng và vinh quang.
vi.B: Vậy hãy khoác lấy uy nghi và tôn nghiêm; \q hãy mặc lấy huy hoàng và vinh quang.
vi.R: Vậy hãy mặc cho mình uy nghi và cao cả, \q và khoác vinh quang rực rỡ như áo bào của vua.

ko.L: 이제 위엄과 높음으로 너를 꾸미고, \q 영화와 존귀로 옷 입어라.
ko.B: 그렇다면 위엄과 존엄으로 단장하고 \q 영광과 광채로 옷 입어 보아라.
ko.R: 그렇다면 위엄과 위대함으로 차려입고 \q 영광과 광채를 왕의 옷처럼 입어 보아라.

pt.L: Adorna-te, pois, de majestade e de grandeza, \q e veste-te de esplendor e de glória.
pt.B: Então reveste-te de majestade e dignidade; \q veste-te de esplendor e de glória.
pt.R: Então veste-te de majestade e grandeza, \q e põe a glória e o esplendor como roupas de rei.

decisions.choice: the clothing of God the King
decisions.reason: These are the words used of God's own royal clothing: "you are clothed with splendor and glory" (Psalm 104:1; also 93:1). God tells Job to dress as God does, as if he could take God's place.

decisions.choice: commands of challenge
decisions.reason: The commands of verses 10-14 are a challenge: if Job can rule the world better, let him try.

decisions.choice: like royal robes
decisions.reason: Readable adds a few words to make the picture of a king's clothing clear (m1).

source.text: הָ֭פֵץ עֶבְר֣וֹת אַפֶּ֑ךָ וּרְאֵ֥ה כָל־גֵּ֝אֶ֗ה וְהַשְׁפִּילֵֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Scatter the outpourings of your anger, and see every proud [one] and bring him low.

en.L: Pour out the overflowings of your anger, \q and look at everyone proud and bring him low.
en.B: Unleash the fury of your anger; \q look at all who are proud and bring them down.
en.R: Let your anger pour out. \q Look at every proud person and bring them down.

es.L: Derrama los desbordes de tu ira, \q y mira a todo soberbio y abátelo.
es.B: Da rienda suelta al furor de tu ira; \q mira a todos los orgullosos y derríbalos.
es.R: Deja que tu enojo se desborde. \q Mira a cada persona orgullosa y derríbala.

fr.L: Répands les débordements de ta colère, \q et regarde tout orgueilleux et abaisse-le.
fr.B: Laisse éclater la fureur de ta colère ; \q regarde tous les orgueilleux et abats-les.
fr.R: Laisse déborder ta colère. \q Regarde tous ceux qui sont fiers, et fais-les tomber.

sw.L: Mwaga mafuriko ya hasira yako, \q umtazame kila mwenye kiburi umshushe.
sw.B: Ifungulie ghadhabu ya hasira yako; \q watazame wote wenye kiburi uwashushe.
sw.R: Acha hasira yako imwagike. \q Mtazame kila mtu mwenye kiburi umshushe chini.

vi.L: Hãy trút đổ những cơn thịnh nộ tràn dâng của ngươi, \q hãy nhìn mọi kẻ kiêu ngạo và hạ kẻ ấy xuống.
vi.B: Hãy để cơn giận ngươi bùng lên dữ dội; \q hãy nhìn mọi kẻ kiêu ngạo và hạ chúng xuống.
vi.R: Hãy để cơn giận của ngươi tuôn trào. \q Hãy nhìn từng kẻ kiêu ngạo và hạ chúng xuống.

ko.L: 네 진노의 넘침을 쏟아붓고, \q 교만한 자를 모두 보고 그를 낮추어라.
ko.B: 네 분노를 마음껏 터뜨려 \q 교만한 자들을 모두 살펴 끌어내려라.
ko.R: 네 화를 쏟아 내 보아라. \q 교만한 사람을 하나하나 보고 끌어내려라.

pt.L: Derrama os transbordamentos da tua ira, \q e olha para todo soberbo e abate-o.
pt.B: Solta a fúria da tua ira; \q olha para todos os orgulhosos e derruba-os.
pt.R: Deixa a tua ira transbordar. \q Olha para cada pessoa orgulhosa e derruba-a.

decisions.choice: scatter the outpourings of your anger: let your fury loose
decisions.reason: The verb means to scatter or spread out; the noun means an overflowing, a flood of rage. Job is told to let his anger loose on the proud, as God does.

decisions.choice: bringing down the proud is God's work
decisions.reason: Humbling the proud is what God claims to do (Isaiah 2:12; 1 Samuel 2:7). Job has complained that the wicked prosper (21:7); can he do better?

decisions.choice: all who are proud ... them (B); every proud person ... them (R)
decisions.reason: The proud are anyone, men or women. Literal keeps the Hebrew "him"; Balanced and Readable use "them".

source.text: רְאֵ֣ה כָל־גֵּ֭אֶה הַכְנִיעֵ֑הוּ וַהֲדֹ֖ךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: See every proud [one], humble him, and tread down [the] wicked in their place.

en.L: Look at everyone proud [and] humble him, \q and tread down the wicked where they stand.
en.B: Look at all who are proud and humble them; \q crush the wicked where they stand.
en.R: Look at every proud person and humble them. \q Crush the wicked right where they are.

es.L: Mira a todo soberbio [y] humíllalo, \q y aplasta a los malvados donde están.
es.B: Mira a todos los orgullosos y humíllalos; \q pisotea a los malvados en su lugar.
es.R: Mira a cada persona orgullosa y humíllala. \q Aplasta a los malvados ahí mismo donde están.

fr.L: Regarde tout orgueilleux [et] humilie-le, \q et écrase les méchants sur place.
fr.B: Regarde tous les orgueilleux et humilie-les ; \q écrase les méchants là où ils se tiennent.
fr.R: Regarde chaque orgueilleux et humilie-le. \q Écrase les méchants là où ils sont.

sw.L: Mtazame kila mwenye kiburi [na] umnyenyekeze, \q uwakanyage waovu mahali walipo.
sw.B: Watazame wote wenye kiburi uwanyenyekeze; \q uwaponde waovu papo hapo walipo.
sw.R: Mtazame kila mtu mwenye kiburi umshushe. \q Waponde waovu pale pale walipo.

vi.L: Hãy nhìn mọi kẻ kiêu ngạo [và] hạ nhục kẻ ấy, \q và giày đạp kẻ ác tại chỗ của chúng.
vi.B: Hãy nhìn mọi kẻ kiêu ngạo và hạ nhục chúng; \q hãy chà đạp kẻ ác ngay tại chỗ chúng đứng.
vi.R: Hãy nhìn từng kẻ kiêu ngạo và hạ nhục chúng. \q Hãy nghiền nát kẻ ác ngay tại chỗ.

ko.L: 교만한 자를 모두 보고 그를 낮추고, \q 악인들을 그 자리에서 짓밟아라.
ko.B: 교만한 자들을 모두 살펴 낮추고 \q 악인들을 선 자리에서 짓밟아라.
ko.R: 교만한 사람을 하나하나 보고 낮추어라. \q 악한 사람들을 그 자리에서 짓밟아라.

pt.L: Olha para todo soberbo [e] humilha-o, \q e esmaga os perversos onde estão.
pt.B: Olha para todos os orgulhosos e humilha-os; \q esmaga os perversos onde estiverem.
pt.R: Olha para cada pessoa orgulhosa e humilha-a. \q Esmaga os perversos ali mesmo onde estão.

decisions.choice: the repeated command: look at every proud one
decisions.reason: The words repeat the second line of verse 11, pressing the challenge home.

decisions.choice: in their place: on the spot, where they stand
decisions.reason: The word means "under them" and so "in their place": right where they are, with no time to escape (34:26).

decisions.choice: all who are proud ... them (B); every proud person ... them (R)
decisions.reason: As in verse 11, Literal keeps "him"; Balanced and Readable use "them" for proud people of any kind.

source.text: טָמְנֵ֣ם בֶּעָפָ֣ר יָ֑חַד פְּ֝נֵיהֶ֗ם חֲבֹ֣שׁ בַּטָּמֽוּן׃

records.literal_gloss: Hide them in the dust together; their faces bind in the hidden [place].

en.L: Hide them in the dust together; \q bind their faces in the hidden place.
en.B: Bury them all together in the dust; \q shroud their faces in the hidden place.
en.R: Bury them all together in the ground. \q Wrap up their faces and shut them away in the grave.

es.L: Escóndelos en el polvo juntos; \q ata sus rostros en el lugar escondido.
es.B: Entiérralos a todos juntos en el polvo; \q envuelve sus rostros en el lugar oculto.
es.R: Entiérralos a todos juntos en la tierra. \q Cúbreles la cara y enciérralos en la tumba.

fr.L: Cache-les dans la poussière ensemble ; \q bande leurs visages dans le lieu caché.
fr.B: Enfouis-les tous ensemble dans la poussière ; \q enveloppe leurs visages dans le lieu caché.
fr.R: Enterre-les tous ensemble dans le sol. \q Couvre leur visage et enferme-les dans la tombe.

sw.L: Wafiche mavumbini pamoja; \q zifunge nyuso zao mahali palipofichika.
sw.B: Wazike wote pamoja mavumbini; \q wafunike nyuso zao mahali palipofichika.
sw.R: Wazike wote pamoja ardhini. \q Wafunge nyuso zao na kuwafungia kaburini.

vi.L: Hãy giấu chúng trong bụi đất cùng nhau; \q hãy bó mặt chúng trong nơi kín giấu.
vi.B: Hãy vùi tất cả chúng chung trong bụi đất; \q hãy liệm mặt chúng trong nơi khuất kín.
vi.R: Hãy chôn tất cả chúng chung dưới đất. \q Hãy bọc mặt chúng lại và nhốt chúng trong mồ.

ko.L: 그들을 함께 티끌 속에 감추고, \q 그들의 얼굴을 숨겨진 곳에 싸매어라.
ko.B: 그들을 모두 함께 흙 속에 묻고 \q 그들의 얼굴을 감추어진 곳에 싸매어라.
ko.R: 그들을 모두 함께 땅에 묻어라. \q 얼굴을 싸매어 무덤 속에 가두어라.

pt.L: Esconde-os no pó juntamente; \q amarra os seus rostos no lugar escondido.
pt.B: Enterra-os todos juntos no pó; \q cobre os seus rostos no lugar escondido.
pt.R: Enterra-os todos juntos no chão. \q Enrola os rostos deles e fecha-os na sepultura.

decisions.choice: hide them in the dust: bury them
decisions.reason: To hide someone in the dust is to put them in the grave.

decisions.choice: the hidden place: the grave, the world of the dead
decisions.reason: The word means something hidden. Here it stands for the grave, or the dark place of the dead below it. Some take it as a prison.

decisions.choice: bind their faces: wrap them as the dead are wrapped
decisions.reason: The verb means to bind or wrap. The dead were wrapped in cloths, the face too (John 11:44).

decisions.choice: Wrap up their faces and shut them away in the grave
alternatives: bind their faces in the hidden place
decisions.reason: Readable says what the hidden place is (m2) and adds "shut them away" to join the two pictures.

source.text: וְגַם־אֲנִ֥י אוֹדֶ֑ךָּ כִּֽי־תוֹשִׁ֖עַ לְךָ֣ יְמִינֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And also I will praise you, that your right hand can save you.

en.L: Then I myself will also praise you, \q that your own right hand can save you.
en.B: Then I myself will admit to you \q that your own right hand can save you.
en.R: Then I will agree \q that you can save yourself by your own power.

es.L: Entonces también yo mismo te alabaré, \q porque tu propia diestra te puede salvar.
es.B: Entonces yo mismo reconoceré ante ti \q que tu propia diestra te puede salvar.
es.R: Entonces yo admitiré \q que puedes salvarte con tu propio poder.

fr.L: Alors moi aussi, je te louerai, \q car ta propre droite peut te sauver.
fr.B: Alors moi-même je reconnaîtrai devant toi \q que ta propre droite peut te sauver.
fr.R: Alors j’admettrai \q que tu peux te sauver par ta propre force.

sw.L: Ndipo mimi pia nitakusifu, \q kwamba mkono wako wa kuume waweza kukuokoa.
sw.B: Ndipo mimi mwenyewe nitakukiri \q kwamba mkono wako wa kuume waweza kukuokoa.
sw.R: Ndipo nitakubali \q kwamba unaweza kujiokoa kwa nguvu zako mwenyewe.

vi.L: Bấy giờ chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ ca ngợi ngươi, \q vì tay phải của ngươi có thể cứu ngươi.
vi.B: Bấy giờ chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ công nhận với ngươi \q rằng tay phải của ngươi có thể cứu được ngươi.
vi.R: Bấy giờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đồng ý \q rằng ngươi có thể tự cứu mình bằng sức của chính ngươi.

ko.L: 그러면 나 또한 너를 칭송하겠다. \q 네 오른손이 너를 구원할 수 있다고.
ko.B: 그러면 나 자신도 네게 인정하겠다. \q 네 오른손이 너를 구원할 수 있다고.
ko.R: 그러면 나도 인정하겠다. \q 네가 네 힘으로 너 자신을 구원할 수 있다고.

pt.L: Então eu também te louvarei, \q porque a tua própria mão direita te pode salvar.
pt.B: Então eu mesmo vou reconhecer diante de ti \q que a tua própria mão direita pode te salvar.
pt.R: Então eu vou concordar \q que podes salvar a ti mesmo com o teu próprio poder.

decisions.choice: praise: acknowledge, give credit
decisions.reason: The verb (yadah, causative) means to praise or to acknowledge openly. God says he would grant Job the credit: Job could save himself.

decisions.choice: your right hand can save you: you have power to save yourself
decisions.reason: The right hand stands for power, and saving is usually God's work (Psalm 98:1). The point is that Job cannot; only God saves.

decisions.choice: admit to you (B); agree (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "praise". In this challenge the sense is to grant a point (m1), so Balanced says "admit" and Readable "agree".

decisions.choice: by your own power
decisions.reason: Readable says what the right hand stands for (m2).

source.text: הִנֵּה־נָ֣א בְ֭הֵמוֹת אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂ֣יתִי עִמָּ֑ךְ חָ֝צִ֗יר כַּבָּקָ֥ר יֹאכֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, please, [at] Behemoth, which I made with you; grass like the ox it eats.

en.L: Look now at Behemoth, which I made along with you; \q it eats grass like the ox.
en.B: Look at Behemoth, which I made just as I made you; \q it eats grass like an ox.
en.R: Look at Behemoth, the great beast I made, just as I made you. \q It eats grass like an ox.

es.L: Mira ahora a Behemot, que hice junto contigo; \q come hierba como el buey.
es.B: Mira a Behemot, al que hice igual que a ti; \q come hierba como un buey.
es.R: Mira a Behemot, la gran bestia que hice, igual que te hice a ti. \q Come hierba como un buey.

fr.L: Regarde donc Béhémoth, que j’ai fait avec toi ; \q il mange l’herbe comme le bœuf.
fr.B: Regarde Béhémoth, que j’ai fait tout comme je t’ai fait ; \q il mange de l’herbe comme un bœuf.
fr.R: Regarde Béhémoth, la grande bête que j’ai faite, comme je t’ai fait, toi. \q Il mange de l’herbe comme un bœuf.

sw.L: Tazama sasa Behemothi, niliyemfanya pamoja nawe; \q hula majani kama ng'ombe.
sw.B: Mtazame Behemothi, niliyemfanya kama nilivyokufanya wewe; \q hula majani kama ng'ombe.
sw.R: Mtazame Behemothi, mnyama mkubwa niliyemfanya, kama nilivyokufanya wewe. \q Hula majani kama ng'ombe.

vi.L: Nào, hãy xem Bê-hê-mốt, mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã dựng nên cùng với ngươi; \q nó ăn cỏ như bò.
vi.B: Hãy nhìn Bê-hê-mốt, loài {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã dựng nên cũng như đã dựng nên ngươi; \q nó ăn cỏ như bò.
vi.R: Hãy nhìn Bê-hê-mốt, con thú lớn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã tạo ra, cũng như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã tạo ra ngươi. \q Nó ăn cỏ như bò.

ko.L: 이제 베헤못을 보아라. 내가 너와 함께 만든 것이다. \q 그것이 소처럼 풀을 먹는다.
ko.B: 베헤못을 보아라. 내가 너를 만든 것처럼 그것도 만들었다. \q 그것은 소처럼 풀을 먹는다.
ko.R: 베헤못을 보아라. 내가 너를 만든 것처럼 만든 큰 짐승이다. \q 그것은 소처럼 풀을 먹는다.

pt.L: Olha agora para Beemote, que eu fiz junto contigo; \q ele come capim como o boi.
pt.B: Olha para Beemote, que eu fiz assim como fiz a ti; \q ele come capim como um boi.
pt.R: Olha para Beemote, o grande animal que eu fiz, assim como fiz a ti. \q Ele come capim como um boi.

decisions.choice: Behemoth: "the great beast", a huge land animal
decisions.reason: The word is the plural of the common word for a beast (behemah), used here as a name: the beast of beasts. Its home among reeds and rivers (verses 21-23) fits the hippopotamus best, and many identify it so; others think of the elephant, or of a creature of the old poems standing for untamed power, like Leviathan (40:25). The name is kept at every level.

decisions.choice: which I made with you: a fellow creature
decisions.reason: "With you" means "as I made you". Behemoth and Job are both God's creatures; the huge beast that eats grass like an ox is no threat to God.

decisions.choice: God's second survey of creatures
decisions.reason: After the challenge of verses 7-14, God shows Job two great creatures: Behemoth (40:15-24) and Leviathan (40:25-41:26).

decisions.choice: Behemoth, the great beast
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the name and adds what it means (m1).

decisions.choice: "Behemothi" with personal agreement ("niliyemfanya", "hula")
alternatives: "behemothi" as a common noun in class 9
decisions.reason: The name stands for one living creature, so it takes the agreement of living beings, as names for animals do in Swahili.

decisions.choice: Beemote, as a name without the article; "Beemote, o grande animal" (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (40:15-24): the Portuguese form of the name, written as a name like "Leviatã" (3:8), as the English keeps "Behemoth". The meaning note keeps the identification open (m1), so the name is not replaced by an animal; Readable adds what it means, as the English Readable does.

source.text: הִנֵּה־נָ֣א כֹח֣וֹ בְמָתְנָ֑יו וְ֝אֹנ֗וֹ בִּשְׁרִירֵ֥י בִטְנֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, please, its strength [is] in its loins, and its power in [the] muscles of its belly.

en.L: Look now, its strength [is] in its loins, \q and its power in the muscles of its belly.
en.B: See the strength in its hips, \q the power in the muscles of its belly!
en.R: See how strong its hips are \q and how powerful the muscles of its belly!

es.L: Mira ahora, su fuerza [está] en sus lomos, \q y su vigor en los músculos de su vientre.
es.B: ¡Mira la fuerza de sus caderas, \q el vigor de los músculos de su vientre!
es.R: ¡Mira qué fuertes son sus caderas \q y qué poderosos los músculos de su vientre!

fr.L: Vois donc, sa force [est] dans ses reins, \q et sa vigueur dans les muscles de son ventre.
fr.B: Vois la force de ses hanches, \q la puissance des muscles de son ventre !
fr.R: Vois comme ses hanches sont fortes \q et comme les muscles de son ventre sont puissants !

sw.L: Tazama sasa, nguvu zake [zi] katika viuno vyake, \q na uwezo wake katika misuli ya tumbo lake.
sw.B: Ona nguvu zilizo katika nyonga zake, \q uwezo ulio katika misuli ya tumbo lake!
sw.R: Ona jinsi nyonga zake zilivyo na nguvu, \q na jinsi misuli ya tumbo lake ilivyo imara!

vi.L: Nào, hãy xem, sức mạnh nó [ở] nơi lưng nó, \q và quyền lực nó ở nơi bắp thịt bụng nó.
vi.B: Hãy xem sức mạnh nơi hông nó, \q và sức lực nơi bắp thịt bụng nó!
vi.R: Hãy xem hông nó khỏe biết bao, \q và bắp thịt bụng nó mạnh mẽ dường nào!

ko.L: 보아라, 그 힘은 허리에 [있고], \q 그 기운은 배의 근육에 있다.
ko.B: 그 허리에 있는 힘을 보아라. \q 배의 근육에 서린 기운을 보아라!
ko.R: 그 허리가 얼마나 튼튼하고 \q 배의 근육이 얼마나 힘센지 보아라!

pt.L: Olha agora, a sua força [está] nos seus lombos, \q e o seu vigor nos músculos do seu ventre.
pt.B: Vê a força dos seus quadris, \q o vigor dos músculos da sua barriga!
pt.R: Vê como os seus quadris são fortes \q e como são poderosos os músculos da sua barriga!

decisions.choice: muscles: the firm sinews of the belly
decisions.reason: The word occurs only here; it seems to mean muscles or sinews, things that are firm and strong.

decisions.choice: loins: hips and lower back, the seat of strength
decisions.reason: The loins are the hips and lower back, often named as the place of a creature's strength (Nahum 2:2).

decisions.choice: hips
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use a word most readers know for the part of the body meant (m2).

source.text: יַחְפֹּ֣ץ זְנָב֣וֹ כְמוֹ־אָ֑רֶז גִּידֵ֖י פַחֲדָ֣יו יְשֹׂרָֽגוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: It stiffens its tail like a cedar; [the] sinews of its thighs are knit together.

en.L: It makes its tail stiff like a cedar; \q the sinews of its thighs are knit together.
en.B: Its tail stiffens like a cedar; \q the sinews of its thighs are tightly woven.
en.R: Its tail is as stiff as a cedar tree. \q The muscles of its legs are tightly knit.

es.L: Pone rígida su cola como un cedro; \q los tendones de sus muslos están entretejidos.
es.B: Su cola se pone tiesa como un cedro; \q los tendones de sus muslos están bien trenzados.
es.R: Su cola es tan rígida como un cedro. \q Los músculos de sus patas están fuertemente unidos.

fr.L: Il raidit sa queue comme un cèdre ; \q les tendons de ses cuisses sont entrelacés.
fr.B: Sa queue se dresse, raide comme un cèdre ; \q les tendons de ses cuisses sont étroitement tressés.
fr.R: Sa queue est raide comme un cèdre. \q Les muscles de ses pattes sont serrés et solides.

sw.L: Huukaza mkia wake kama mwerezi; \q mishipa ya mapaja yake imesokotana.
sw.B: Mkia wake hukakamaa kama mwerezi; \q mishipa ya mapaja yake imefumwa pamoja kwa nguvu.
sw.R: Mkia wake ni mgumu kama mti wa mwerezi. \q Misuli ya miguu yake imeshikamana sana.

vi.L: Nó dựng cứng đuôi nó như cây bá hương; \q gân đùi nó đan kết vào nhau.
vi.B: Đuôi nó cứng như cây bá hương; \q gân đùi nó đan chặt vào nhau.
vi.R: Đuôi nó cứng như cây bá hương. \q Bắp thịt chân nó săn chắc.

ko.L: 그것은 꼬리를 백향목처럼 뻣뻣이 세우고, \q 그 넓적다리의 힘줄은 서로 얽혀 있다.
ko.B: 그 꼬리는 백향목처럼 꼿꼿하고 \q 넓적다리의 힘줄은 단단히 엮여 있다.
ko.R: 그 꼬리는 백향목처럼 뻣뻣하다. \q 다리 근육은 단단하게 엮여 있다.

pt.L: Ele enrijece a sua cauda como um cedro; \q os tendões das suas coxas estão entrelaçados.
pt.B: A sua cauda fica rija como um cedro; \q os tendões das suas coxas são bem trançados.
pt.R: A sua cauda é dura como um cedro. \q Os músculos das suas pernas são firmes e trançados.

decisions.choice: its tail
decisions.reason: The word means tail. A hippopotamus has a short tail, so some think the picture is of strength in general, or of an elephant's trunk; others take the cedar to describe the tail's stiffness, not its size. The word itself is "tail".

decisions.choice: its thighs
decisions.reason: The word occurs with this sense only here; its spelling is the same as the word for fear (39:16, 22), but the sense here is the thighs, as in Aramaic.

decisions.choice: knit together: intertwined
decisions.reason: The verb, found only here, pictures sinews woven or braided together, tight and strong.

source.text: עֲ֭צָמָיו אֲפִיקֵ֣י נְחוּשָׁ֑ה גְּ֝רָמָ֗יו כִּמְטִ֥יל בַּרְזֶֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: Its bones [are] tubes of bronze; its limbs [are] like a bar of iron.

en.L: Its bones [are] tubes of bronze, \q its limbs like a bar of iron.
en.B: Its bones are pipes of bronze, \q its limbs like bars of iron.
en.R: Its bones are as strong as bronze pipes, \q its legs as strong as iron bars.

es.L: Sus huesos [son] tubos de bronce, \q sus miembros como barra de hierro.
es.B: Sus huesos son caños de bronce, \q sus miembros como barras de hierro.
es.R: Sus huesos son tan fuertes como tubos de bronce, \q sus patas tan fuertes como barras de hierro.

fr.L: Ses os [sont] des tubes de bronze, \q ses membres comme une barre de fer.
fr.B: Ses os sont des tuyaux de bronze, \q ses membres comme des barres de fer.
fr.R: Ses os sont aussi solides que des tuyaux de bronze, \q ses pattes aussi solides que des barres de fer.

sw.L: Mifupa yake [ni] mirija ya shaba, \q viungo vyake kama mtalimbo wa chuma.
sw.B: Mifupa yake ni mabomba ya shaba, \q viungo vyake kama nondo za chuma.
sw.R: Mifupa yake ina nguvu kama mabomba ya shaba, \q miguu yake ina nguvu kama nondo za chuma.

vi.L: Xương nó [là] những ống đồng, \q các chi nó như thanh sắt.
vi.B: Xương nó là những ống đồng, \q tay chân nó như những thanh sắt.
vi.R: Xương nó cứng như ống đồng, \q chân nó chắc như thanh sắt.

ko.L: 그 뼈는 놋 관이고, \q 그 사지는 쇠 막대 같다.
ko.B: 그 뼈는 놋쇠 관이고 \q 그 사지는 쇠막대들 같다.
ko.R: 그 뼈는 놋쇠 관처럼 단단하고 \q 다리는 쇠막대처럼 튼튼하다.

pt.L: Os seus ossos [são] tubos de bronze, \q os seus membros como uma barra de ferro.
pt.B: Os seus ossos são canos de bronze, \q os seus membros, como barras de ferro.
pt.R: Os seus ossos são fortes como canos de bronze, \q as suas pernas, fortes como barras de ferro.

decisions.choice: tubes: channels, hollow pipes
decisions.reason: The word is used of stream channels (6:15); here it pictures long, strong bones like metal pipes.

decisions.choice: bones, limbs: the creature's frame
decisions.reason: Two words for bones stand side by side, as the two lines of the verse say the same thing twice.

decisions.choice: as strong as
decisions.reason: Readable says what the comparison is about: strength.

source.text: ה֭וּארֵאשִׁ֣ית דַּרְכֵי־אֵ֑ל הָ֝עֹשׂוֹ יַגֵּ֥שׁ חַרְבּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: It [is the] first of [the] ways of God; the one who made it, let him bring near his sword.

en.L: It [is the] first of the ways of God; \q let the one who made it bring near {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sword.
en.B: It is the first of the works of God; \q only its Maker can come near it with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sword.
en.R: It is the greatest of the creatures God made. \q Only the God who made it can come near it with a sword.

es.L: Él [es el] primero de los caminos de Dios; \q el que lo hizo, que acerque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} espada.
es.B: Es la primera de las obras de Dios; \q solo su Hacedor puede acercarse a él con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} espada.
es.R: Es la mayor de las criaturas que Dios hizo. \q Solo el Dios que lo hizo puede acercarse a él con una espada.

fr.L: Il [est] le premier des chemins de Dieu ; \q que celui qui l’a fait approche {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} épée.
fr.B: Il est le premier des ouvrages de Dieu ; \q seul celui qui l’a fait peut l’approcher avec {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} épée.
fr.R: C’est la plus grande des créatures que Dieu a faites. \q Seul le Dieu qui l’a fait peut s’en approcher avec une épée.

sw.L: Yeye [ni] wa kwanza wa njia za Mungu; \q aliyemfanya na alete karibu upanga {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: Yeye ni wa kwanza kati ya kazi za Mungu; \q ni Muumba wake tu awezaye kumkaribia na upanga {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.R: Ndiye mkuu wa viumbe vyote alivyoviumba Mungu. \q Ni Mungu aliyemuumba tu anayeweza kumkaribia kwa upanga.

vi.L: Nó [là] đầu tiên trong các đường lối của Đức Chúa Trời; \q Đấng đã làm ra nó, hãy để Đấng ấy đưa gươm của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại gần.
vi.B: Nó là công trình hàng đầu của Đức Chúa Trời; \q chỉ Đấng tạo ra nó mới có thể cầm gươm của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến gần nó.
vi.R: Nó là loài lớn nhất trong các loài Đức Chúa Trời đã dựng nên. \q Chỉ Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng tạo ra nó, mới có thể cầm gươm đến gần nó.

ko.L: 그것은 하나님의 길 가운데 첫째이다. \q 그것을 지은 이가 자기 칼을 가까이 대게 하라.
ko.B: 그것은 하나님이 만든 것 가운데 으뜸이다. \q 그것을 지은 이만이 자기 칼을 들고 그것에게 다가갈 수 있다.
ko.R: 그것은 하나님이 만든 짐승 가운데 가장 크다. \q 그것을 만든 하나님만이 칼을 들고 다가갈 수 있다.

pt.L: Ele [é o] primeiro dos caminhos de Deus; \q aquele que o fez, que aproxime a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} espada.
pt.B: Ele é a primeira das obras de Deus; \q só o seu Criador pode chegar perto dele com a espada.
pt.R: Ele é o maior dos animais que Deus fez. \q Só o Deus que o criou pode chegar perto dele com uma espada.

decisions.choice: the first of the ways of God: the chief of his works
decisions.reason: "First" (reshit) can mean first in time or first in rank. "Ways" here means works, as in Proverbs 8:22, where wisdom is "the first of his way". Behemoth is the masterpiece of God's works on land.

decisions.choice: only its Maker can approach it with the sword
alternatives: its Maker gave it its sword
let its Maker bring his sword near
decisions.reason: The line is hard. Read as it stands, it says that only God, who made Behemoth, can come at it with a sword; no human can. Some take "his sword" as Behemoth's own weapon, its great teeth or tusks, given to it by its Maker.

decisions.choice: God speaks of himself in the third person
decisions.reason: As in 39:17 and 40:9, God names himself ("God", "the one who made it").

decisions.choice: only
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "only" to say what the wish implies, as m2 reads the line; the alternative is in the footnote.

source.text: כִּֽי־ב֭וּל הָרִ֣ים יִשְׂאוּ־ל֑וֹ וְֽכָל־חַיַּ֥ת הַ֝שָּׂדֶ֗ה יְשַֽׂחֲקוּ־שָֽׁם׃

records.literal_gloss: For [the] produce of [the] mountains they bring to it, and every animal of the field plays there.

en.L: For the mountains bring it [their] produce, \q and all the animals of the field play there.
en.B: The hills bring it their produce, \q and all the wild animals play nearby.
en.R: The hills provide food for it, \q and all the wild animals play near it.

es.L: Porque los montes le traen [su] producto, \q y todas las bestias del campo juegan allí.
es.B: Las colinas le traen sus frutos, \q y todas las fieras juegan cerca.
es.R: Las colinas le dan de comer, \q y todos los animales salvajes juegan cerca de él.

fr.L: Car les montagnes lui apportent [leur] produit, \q et toutes les bêtes des champs y jouent.
fr.B: Les collines lui apportent leurs produits, \q et toutes les bêtes sauvages jouent tout près.
fr.R: Les collines lui fournissent sa nourriture, \q et toutes les bêtes sauvages jouent près de lui.

sw.L: Kwa maana milima humletea mazao [yake], \q na wanyama wote wa porini hucheza huko.
sw.B: Vilima humletea mazao yake, \q na wanyama wote wa porini hucheza karibu.
sw.R: Vilima humpa chakula, \q na wanyama wote wa porini hucheza karibu naye.

vi.L: Vì núi non đem sản vật [của chúng] đến cho nó, \q và mọi loài thú đồng chơi đùa tại đó.
vi.B: Đồi núi cung cấp sản vật cho nó, \q và mọi thú hoang chơi đùa gần bên.
vi.R: Đồi núi cho nó thức ăn, \q và mọi thú hoang nô đùa gần nó.

ko.L: 산들이 그것에게 [그] 소산을 가져오고, \q 들의 모든 짐승이 거기서 뛰논다.
ko.B: 언덕들이 그것에게 산물을 내어 주고 \q 들짐승들이 모두 그 곁에서 뛰논다.
ko.R: 언덕들이 그것에게 먹이를 주고 \q 들짐승들은 모두 그 곁에서 뛰어논다.

pt.L: Pois os montes lhe trazem [o seu] produto, \q e todos os animais do campo brincam ali.
pt.B: As colinas lhe trazem o que produzem, \q e todos os animais selvagens brincam por perto.
pt.R: As colinas lhe dão comida, \q e todos os animais selvagens brincam perto dele.

decisions.choice: produce: the food the land yields
decisions.reason: The word means what the land produces, its yield of plants. The hills feed Behemoth with grass (verse 15).

decisions.choice: the wild animals play there unafraid
decisions.reason: Though Behemoth is huge, the other animals play near it without fear, since it eats plants, not them. The same verb "play" is used in Psalm 104:26 of Leviathan in the sea.

decisions.choice: nearby (B); near it (R)
decisions.reason: "There" means where Behemoth is; Balanced and Readable make that clear.

source.text: תַּֽחַת־צֶאֱלִ֥ים יִשְׁכָּ֑ב בְּסֵ֖תֶר קָנֶ֣ה וּבִצָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Under [the] lotus plants it lies, in [the] hiding place of reed and swamp.

en.L: Under the lotus plants it lies, \q in the hiding place of reed and swamp.
en.B: It lies under the lotus plants, \q hidden among the reeds of the marsh.
en.R: It lies under the thorny lotus bushes, \q hidden in the tall reeds of the swamp.

es.L: Bajo los lotos se acuesta, \q en el escondite de la caña y del pantano.
es.B: Se echa bajo los lotos, \q escondido entre las cañas del pantano.
es.R: Se echa bajo los arbustos espinosos de loto, \q escondido entre las cañas altas del pantano.

fr.L: Sous les lotus il se couche, \q dans la cachette du roseau et du marais.
fr.B: Il se couche sous les lotus, \q caché parmi les roseaux du marécage.
fr.R: Il se couche sous les buissons épineux de lotus, \q caché dans les grands roseaux du marais.

sw.L: Chini ya mikunazi hulala, \q mahali pa kujificha pa matete na kinamasi.
sw.B: Hulala chini ya mikunazi, \q amejificha kati ya matete ya bwawa.
sw.R: Hulala chini ya vichaka vya mikunazi yenye miiba, \q amejificha katika matete marefu ya kinamasi.

vi.L: Dưới các bụi táo gai nó nằm, \q trong chỗ ẩn của lau sậy và đầm lầy.
vi.B: Nó nằm dưới các bụi táo gai, \q ẩn mình giữa lau sậy nơi đầm lầy.
vi.R: Nó nằm dưới các bụi táo gai, \q ẩn trong đám lau sậy cao nơi đầm lầy.

ko.L: 가시덤불 아래 그것이 눕고, \q 갈대와 늪의 숨는 곳에 [눕는다].
ko.B: 그것은 가시덤불 아래 누워 \q 늪의 갈대 속에 숨어 있다.
ko.R: 그것은 가시덤불 아래 누워 \q 늪의 키 큰 갈대 속에 숨어 있다.

pt.L: Debaixo dos lótus ele se deita, \q no esconderijo do junco e do pântano.
pt.B: Ele se deita debaixo dos lótus, \q escondido entre os juncos do brejo.
pt.R: Ele se deita debaixo dos arbustos espinhosos de lótus, \q escondido entre os juncos altos do pântano.

decisions.choice: lotus plants: the thorny lotus, a shrub of hot river valleys
decisions.reason: The word occurs only here and in verse 22. It names a thorny shrub (the lotus jujube) that grows in hot, wet places such as the Jordan valley, not the water lily also called lotus.

decisions.choice: reeds and swamp: the home of a river animal
decisions.reason: Reeds and marshes are the home of the hippopotamus, which spends the day in water and shade (see verse 15).

decisions.choice: thorny lotus bushes
decisions.reason: Readable adds "thorny" and "bushes" so readers do not picture water lilies (m1).

decisions.choice: "mikunazi"
decisions.reason: The plant is the thorny lotus jujube (m1), and Swahili has its own name for the jujube tree, "mkunazi"; "yungiyungi" is the water lily, which the meaning decision rules out.

decisions.choice: "bụi táo gai" (thorny jujube bushes)
decisions.reason: "Sen" is the water lily, which the meaning decision rules out (m1); "táo gai" names a thorny jujube shrub.

decisions.choice: "가시덤불" (thorny bushes)
decisions.reason: 연꽃 is the water lily, which m1 rules out; Korean has no common name for the lotus jujube, so the thorny shrub is named by its kind.

source.text: יְסֻכֻּ֣הוּ צֶאֱלִ֣ים צִֽלֲל֑וֹ יְ֝סֻבּ֗וּהוּ עַרְבֵי־נָֽחַל׃

records.literal_gloss: They cover it, [the] lotus plants, [as] its shade; [the] poplars of [the] wadi surround it.

en.L: The lotus plants cover it [with] their shade; \q the poplars of the stream surround it.
en.B: The lotus bushes cover it with their shade; \q the poplars by the stream surround it.
en.R: The thorny lotus bushes give it shade, \q and the poplars by the stream grow all around it.

es.L: Los lotos lo cubren [con] su sombra; \q los álamos del arroyo lo rodean.
es.B: Los arbustos de loto lo cubren con su sombra; \q los álamos del arroyo lo rodean.
es.R: Los arbustos espinosos de loto le dan sombra, \q y los álamos del arroyo crecen a su alrededor.

fr.L: Les lotus le couvrent [de] leur ombre ; \q les peupliers du torrent l’entourent.
fr.B: Les buissons de lotus le couvrent de leur ombre ; \q les peupliers du ruisseau l’entourent.
fr.R: Les buissons épineux de lotus lui donnent de l’ombre, \q et les peupliers du ruisseau poussent tout autour de lui.

sw.L: Mikunazi humfunika [kwa] kivuli chake; \q mipopla ya kijito humzunguka.
sw.B: Vichaka vya mikunazi humfunika kwa kivuli chake; \q mipopla ya kando ya kijito humzunguka.
sw.R: Vichaka vya mikunazi yenye miiba humpa kivuli, \q na mipopla ya kando ya kijito huota kumzunguka.

vi.L: Các bụi táo gai che phủ nó [bằng] bóng mát của chúng; \q các cây dương bên suối bao quanh nó.
vi.B: Các bụi táo gai lấy bóng mát che phủ nó; \q hàng dương bên dòng suối vây quanh nó.
vi.R: Các bụi táo gai cho nó bóng mát, \q và hàng cây dương bên suối mọc quanh nó.

ko.L: 가시덤불이 그 그늘로 그것을 덮고, \q 시냇가의 백양나무들이 그것을 둘러싼다.
ko.B: 가시덤불이 그늘을 드리워 그것을 덮고 \q 시냇가의 백양나무들이 그것을 에워싼다.
ko.R: 가시덤불이 그것에게 그늘을 만들어 주고 \q 시냇가의 백양나무들이 그 둘레에 자란다.

pt.L: Os lótus o cobrem [com] a sua sombra; \q os choupos do ribeiro o cercam.
pt.B: Os arbustos de lótus o cobrem com a sua sombra; \q os choupos à beira do ribeiro o rodeiam.
pt.R: Os arbustos espinhosos de lótus lhe dão sombra, \q e os choupos à beira do ribeiro crescem ao redor dele.

decisions.choice: the poplars of the stream: trees of the wadi
decisions.reason: The trees ("aravim") grow by water (Leviticus 23:40; Psalm 137:2). Older translations say "willows"; the tree meant is most likely the Euphrates poplar. The stream is a wadi, a valley with running water at least for part of the year.

decisions.choice: its shade: as shade for it
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "its shade": the bushes become shade for Behemoth.

decisions.choice: with their shade
decisions.reason: English reads "their shade" more easily, since the shade is the bushes' (m2).

source.text: הֵ֤ן יַעֲשֹׁ֣ק נָ֭הָר לֹ֣א יַחְפּ֑וֹז יִבְטַ֓ח׀כִּֽי־יָגִ֖יחַ יַרְדֵּ֣ן אֶל־פִּֽיהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, [the] river rages, it is not alarmed; it is confident though [the] Jordan bursts against its mouth.

en.L: Look, [if] the river rages, it is not alarmed; \q it is confident though [the] Jordan bursts against its mouth.
en.B: Even when the river surges, it is not alarmed; \q it stays calm though the Jordan rushes against its mouth.
en.R: When the river floods, it is not afraid. \q It stays calm even if a river like the Jordan rushes into its mouth.

es.L: Mira, [si] el río se embravece, no se alarma; \q está confiado aunque [el] Jordán irrumpa contra su boca.
es.B: Aunque el río crezca, no se alarma; \q se queda tranquilo aunque el Jordán se precipite contra su boca.
es.R: Cuando el río se desborda, no tiene miedo. \q Se queda tranquilo aunque un río como el Jordán le entre en la boca.

fr.L: Voici, [si] le fleuve fait rage, il ne s’alarme pas ; \q il reste confiant quand [le] Jourdain se jette contre sa gueule.
fr.B: Même quand le fleuve déborde, il ne s’alarme pas ; \q il reste calme quand le Jourdain se précipite contre sa gueule.
fr.R: Quand la rivière déborde, il n’a pas peur. \q Il reste calme même si un fleuve comme le Jourdain se jette dans sa gueule.

sw.L: Tazama, [hata] mto ukichafuka, hashtuki; \q yu salama ingawa Yordani unafurika hadi kinywani mwake.
sw.B: Hata mto ukifurika, yeye hashtuki; \q hutulia ingawa Yordani unamkimbilia kinywani.
sw.R: Mto unapofurika, haogopi. \q Hutulia hata kama mto kama Yordani unaingia kinywani mwake.

vi.L: Kìa, [dù] sông dâng cuồng nộ, nó chẳng hoảng sợ; \q nó vẫn vững lòng dù [sông] Giô-đanh xô vào miệng nó.
vi.B: Dù sông dâng lũ, nó cũng chẳng hoảng hốt; \q nó vẫn bình thản dù sông Giô-đanh ào vào miệng nó.
vi.R: Khi nước sông dâng lên, nó không sợ. \q Nó vẫn bình thản dù một dòng sông như Giô-đanh tràn vào miệng nó.

ko.L: 보아라, 강이 사납게 넘쳐도 그것은 놀라지 않는다. \q 요단이 그 입으로 밀려들어도 태연하다.
ko.B: 강물이 거세게 불어나도 그것은 놀라지 않고 \q 요단 강이 그 입으로 밀려들어도 태연하다.
ko.R: 강물이 넘쳐도 그것은 두려워하지 않는다. \q 요단 강 같은 강물이 입으로 쏟아져 들어와도 태연하다.

pt.L: Eis que [se] o rio se enfurece, ele não se apressa; \q está confiante ainda que [o] Jordão se precipite contra a sua boca.
pt.B: Mesmo quando o rio transborda, ele não se assusta; \q fica tranquilo ainda que o Jordão se lance contra a sua boca.
pt.R: Quando o rio enche, ele não tem medo. \q Fica tranquilo mesmo que um rio como o Jordão entre na sua boca.

decisions.choice: rages, alarmed: the flood does not make it flee
decisions.reason: The river "oppresses", that is, surges in flood. Behemoth does not hurry away in alarm, as the verb means (Psalm 48:6).

decisions.choice: the Jordan: a river in flood
decisions.reason: The Jordan, Israel's best-known river, floods in spring (Joshua 3:15). It may be named here as a picture of any rushing river; the poem does not need Behemoth to live in the Jordan itself.

decisions.choice: Even when
decisions.reason: The opening word (hen) calls attention and here sets up a condition; Balanced says "even when".

decisions.choice: a river like the Jordan
decisions.reason: Readable makes the comparison explicit, as m2 reads it.

source.text: בְּעֵינָ֥יו יִקָּחֶ֑נּוּ בְּ֝מֽוֹקְשִׁ֗ים יִנְקָב־אָֽף׃

records.literal_gloss: By its eyes will one take it? With snares will one pierce [its] nose?

en.L: Can one take it by its eyes? \q Can one pierce [its] nose with snares?
en.B: Can anyone capture it while it is watching, \q or pierce its nose with a snare?
en.R: Can anyone catch it while it is watching? \q Can anyone trap it and put a ring through its nose?

es.L: ¿Lo tomará alguien por sus ojos? \q ¿Le perforará [la] nariz con lazos?
es.B: ¿Puede alguien capturarlo mientras está mirando, \q o perforarle la nariz con un lazo?
es.R: ¿Puede alguien atraparlo mientras está mirando? \q ¿Puede alguien cazarlo y ponerle un anillo en la nariz?

fr.L: Le prendra-t-on par ses yeux ? \q Lui percera-t-on [le] nez avec des pièges ?
fr.B: Qui pourrait le capturer sous ses yeux \q ou lui percer le nez avec un piège ?
fr.R: Qui peut l’attraper pendant qu’il regarde ? \q Qui peut le piéger et lui passer un anneau dans le nez ?

sw.L: Je, mtu atamkamata kwa macho yake? \q Je, atatoboa pua [yake] kwa mitego?
sw.B: Je, mtu yeyote anaweza kumkamata huku akiwa anatazama, \q au kumtoboa pua kwa mtego?
sw.R: Je, mtu yeyote anaweza kumnasa huku anaona? \q Je, mtu anaweza kumtega na kumtia pete puani?

vi.L: Có ai bắt được nó qua mắt nó chăng? \q Có ai dùng bẫy mà xỏ mũi [nó] chăng?
vi.B: Ai có thể bắt nó khi nó đang nhìn, \q hoặc dùng bẫy mà xỏ mũi nó?
vi.R: Ai có thể bắt nó trong khi nó đang canh chừng? \q Ai có thể bẫy nó và xỏ khoen qua mũi nó?

ko.L: 누가 그 눈으로 그것을 잡겠느냐? \q 누가 올무로 [그] 코를 꿰겠느냐?
ko.B: 그것이 보고 있는데 누가 그것을 사로잡을 수 있겠느냐? \q 누가 올가미로 그 코를 꿸 수 있겠느냐?
ko.R: 그것이 지켜보고 있는데 누가 그것을 붙잡겠느냐? \q 누가 덫으로 잡아 그 코에 고리를 꿰겠느냐?

pt.L: Pode alguém pegá-lo pelos seus olhos? \q Pode alguém furar [o seu] nariz com laços?
pt.B: Pode alguém capturá-lo enquanto ele está vigiando, \q ou furar o seu nariz com um laço?
pt.R: Pode alguém pegá-lo enquanto ele está olhando? \q Pode alguém prendê-lo e pôr uma argola no seu nariz?

decisions.choice: by its eyes: while it is watching, face to face
decisions.reason: "By its eyes" may mean in full view, while it watches; no one could take it by surprise, let alone openly. Some take it as catching it by its eyes with hooks. The question expects "no" either way.

decisions.choice: pierce its nose: lead a captured animal by a ring
decisions.reason: Captured animals, and captives, were led by a hook or ring in the nose (2 Kings 19:28). No one can do this to Behemoth.

decisions.choice: put a ring through its nose
decisions.reason: Readable says why the nose is pierced (m2).

source.text: תִּמְשֹׁ֣ךְ לִוְיָתָ֣ן בְּחַכָּ֑ה וּ֝בְחֶ֗בֶל תַּשְׁקִ֥יעַ לְשֹׁנֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Will you draw out Leviathan with a hook, and with a cord press down its tongue?

en.L: Can you draw out Leviathan with a fishhook, \q or press down its tongue with a cord?
en.B: Can you pull in Leviathan with a fishhook \q or tie down its tongue with a rope?
en.R: Can you catch Leviathan with a fishhook \q or tie down its tongue with a rope?

es.L: ¿Puedes sacar a Leviatán con un anzuelo, \q o apretarle la lengua con un cordel?
es.B: ¿Puedes pescar a Leviatán con un anzuelo \q o atarle la lengua con una cuerda?
es.R: ¿Puedes atrapar a Leviatán con un anzuelo \q o amarrarle la lengua con una cuerda?

fr.L: Peux-tu tirer Léviathan avec un hameçon, \q ou presser sa langue avec une corde ?
fr.B: Peux-tu ramener Léviathan avec un hameçon \q ou lui attacher la langue avec une corde ?
fr.R: Peux-tu attraper Léviathan avec un hameçon \q ou lui ficeler la langue avec une corde ?

decisions.choice: verse numbers: 40:25-32 here is 41:1-8 in many Bibles
decisions.reason: This translation numbers verses as the Hebrew text does. In the Hebrew text chapter 40 runs to verse 32, and chapter 41 has 26 verses. Many Bibles begin chapter 41 here, so 40:25-32 here is 41:1-8 there, and 41:1-26 here is 41:9-34 there.

decisions.choice: Leviathan: the great sea creature of the old poems
decisions.reason: Leviathan is the sea monster of Israel's poems: the many-headed beast God crushed (Psalm 74:14), "the twisting serpent" (Isaiah 27:1), and also a creature God made to play in the sea (Psalm 104:26); see 3:8. Some of what follows fits the crocodile, which no one could catch with a hook; other parts (41:10-13, breathing fire) go beyond any known animal. The name is kept at every level.

decisions.choice: fishhook and cord: the tools of fishing
decisions.reason: God asks whether Job can catch Leviathan as one lands a fish, and hold it down with a line.

decisions.choice: Can you
decisions.reason: The Hebrew question asks both whether Job will and whether he can; the point is that he cannot.

decisions.choice: Leviatã; the verses numbered as the Hebrew (40:25-32, then 41:1-26)
decisions.reason: The name as fixed at 3:8, with no article. The Portuguese follows the files' Hebrew numbering, as the English does (m1); readers whose Bible numbers this 41:1 will find the same text there, which the meaning note explains.

pt.B: Podes passar uma corda pelo seu nariz \q ou furar a sua mandíbula com um gancho?
pt.R: Podes passar uma corda pelo nariz dele \q ou um gancho pela sua mandíbula?

decisions.choice: a rush-cord: a rope made of rushes
decisions.reason: The word means a rush or reed (Isaiah 58:5), and so a rope woven from rushes.

decisions.choice: a hook through the jaw: how a catch or a captive was held
decisions.reason: Fish were strung on hooks or cords through the jaw, and conquerors led captives the same way (Amos 4:2; Ezekiel 29:4, where Pharaoh is pictured as a great river monster caught with hooks).

en.B: Will it keep begging you for mercy? \q Will it speak gently to you?

ko.L: 그것이 너에게 애원을 많이 하겠느냐? \q 너에게 부드러운 [말을] 하겠느냐?
ko.B: 그것이 너에게 자비를 구하며 거듭 애걸하겠느냐? \q 너에게 부드럽게 말하겠느냐?

pt.R: Vai ele implorar que o deixes ir embora? \q Vai falar contigo com gentileza?

decisions.choice: the beast pictured as a beaten captive
decisions.reason: With a touch of humor, God pictures Leviathan as a prisoner of war begging the victor for mercy. The idea is absurd: Leviathan begs no one.

decisions.choice: pleas: requests for favor or mercy
decisions.reason: The word means pleading for grace, as a weaker party pleads with a stronger (Proverbs 18:23).

decisions.choice: a slave of perpetuity: a slave for life
decisions.reason: The phrase is the law's term for a slave who chose to stay with his master for life (Deuteronomy 15:17; Exodus 21:6). God asks whether Leviathan will sign itself over to Job as his property.

decisions.choice: a covenant: a treaty between unequal parties
decisions.reason: Weaker peoples made treaties to serve stronger ones (1 Samuel 11:1). Leviathan will make no such bargain.

decisions.choice: slave at every level
decisions.reason: Being owned for life is the point of the question (m1), so "slave" is kept at every level, as the style guide asks where slavery itself is meant.

decisions.choice: agreement (R)
decisions.reason: Readable uses a common word for the treaty (m2).

sw.R: Je, utacheza naye kana kwamba ni ndege wa kufugwa? \q Je, utamfunga kwa kamba ili wasichana wako wacheze naye?

vi.R: Ngươi có chơi với nó như chơi với con chim cảnh không? \q Ngươi có buộc dây cho các bé gái nhà ngươi dắt nó chơi không?

ko.L: 네가 그것을 새처럼 데리고 놀겠느냐? \q 네 소녀들을 위해 [끈으로] 그것을 매어 두겠느냐?

pt.L: Brincarás com ele como com um pássaro, \q ou o amarrarás [numa coleira] para as tuas meninas?
pt.B: Vais brincar com ele como com um passarinho de estimação \q ou pô-lo numa coleira para as tuas meninas?
pt.R: Vais brincar com ele como se fosse um passarinho de estimação? \q Vais pô-lo numa coleira para as tuas meninas brincarem com ele?

decisions.choice: play with it: only God plays with Leviathan
decisions.reason: Psalm 104:26 speaks of Leviathan, which God formed to play in the sea. What is play for God is beyond any human.

decisions.choice: your girls: young girls of the household
decisions.reason: The word means girls or young women, and can mean servant girls. A pet tied on a string for children to play with is the picture.

decisions.choice: pet bird; on a leash
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what kind of bird and what kind of tying are meant.

en.B: Will traders bargain over it? \q Will they divide it up among the merchants?
en.R: Will fishermen sell it to one another? \q Will they cut it up and sell it to the merchants?

es.R: ¿Se lo venderán los pescadores unos a otros? \q ¿Lo cortarán en pedazos y lo venderán a los comerciantes?

fr.R: Des pêcheurs se le vendront-ils entre eux ? \q Le découperont-ils pour le vendre aux marchands ?

sw.B: Je, wafanyabiashara watapatana bei yake? \q Je, watamgawanya kati ya wachuuzi?
sw.R: Je, wavuvi watauziana yeye? \q Je, watamkata vipande na kuwauzia wafanyabiashara?

vi.L: Các bạn hùn hạp sẽ mặc cả về nó chăng? \q Họ sẽ chia nó ra giữa [các] nhà buôn chăng?
vi.B: Bọn lái buôn có mặc cả về nó không? \q Họ có chia nó ra cho các thương nhân không?
vi.R: Bọn đánh cá có bán nó cho nhau không? \q Họ có xẻ nó ra bán cho các nhà buôn không?

ko.L: 동업자들이 그것을 두고 흥정하겠느냐? \q 그것을 [그] 상인들 사이에 나누겠느냐?
ko.B: 장사꾼들이 그것을 놓고 값을 흥정하겠느냐? \q 그것을 상인들에게 나누어 팔겠느냐?
ko.R: 어부들이 그것을 서로 사고팔겠느냐? \q 그것을 잘라서 상인들에게 팔겠느냐?

pt.L: Negociarão os sócios por ele? \q Vão reparti-lo entre [os] mercadores?
pt.B: Vão os negociantes regatear por ele? \q Vão reparti-lo entre os mercadores?
pt.R: Vão os pescadores vendê-lo uns aos outros? \q Vão cortá-lo em pedaços e vendê-lo aos comerciantes?

decisions.choice: partners: companions in a trade, such as fishermen working together
decisions.reason: The word means companions or partners. Here it seems to mean partners in trade, perhaps fishermen working together, as Luke 5:7 speaks of partners in another boat.

decisions.choice: merchants: literally "Canaanites"
decisions.reason: The Canaanites of the coast, the Phoenicians, were known as traders, and their name came to mean "merchant" (Proverbs 31:24; Zephaniah 1:11).

decisions.choice: bargain over it: trade it, sell it
decisions.reason: The verb means to buy or trade (6:27; Deuteronomy 2:6). God asks whether Leviathan could be caught and sold like any catch of fish.

decisions.choice: fishermen ... sell it to one another
decisions.reason: Readable names the likely partners (m1) and says plainly what the bargaining is.

source.text: הַֽתְמַלֵּ֣א בְשֻׂכּ֣וֹת עוֹר֑וֹ וּבְצִלְצַ֖ל דָּגִ֣ים רֹאשֽׁוֹ׃

fr.R: Peux-tu lui planter des harpons partout dans la peau \q ou lui enfoncer des lances dans la tête ?

vi.R: Ngươi có đâm lao móc khắp da nó \q hay phóng giáo vào đầu nó được không?

ko.L: 네가 작살로 그 가죽을 채우고, \q 고기 잡는 창으로 그 머리를 [채울] 수 있느냐?
ko.B: 네가 그 가죽을 작살로 가득 찌르고 \q 그 머리를 고기 잡는 창으로 찌를 수 있느냐?
ko.R: 네가 그 온몸에 작살을 꽂고 \q 그 머리에 창을 박을 수 있느냐?

pt.L: Podes encher a sua pele de arpões, \q ou a sua cabeça de lanças de pesca?

pt.R: Podes cravar arpões por toda a pele dele \q ou enfiar lanças na sua cabeça?

decisions.choice: harpoons, fishing spears
decisions.reason: Both words occur only here. They name pointed weapons for spearing fish. Leviathan's hide cannot be pierced (41:18-21).

decisions.choice: fishing spears (plural)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has the singular "a spear"; English reads more naturally with the plural to match "harpoons".

source.text: שִׂים־עָלָ֥יו כַּפֶּ֑ךָ זְכֹ֥ר מִ֝לְחָמָ֗ה אַל־תּוֹסַֽף׃

records.literal_gloss: Put upon it your palms; remember [the] battle; do not do [it] again.

en.L: Lay your hand upon it; \q remember the battle; you will not do [it] again.
en.B: Just lay a hand on it, \q and you will remember the fight and never do it again.
en.R: Touch it even once, \q and you will remember the fight and never try it again.

es.L: Pon tu mano sobre él; \q acuérdate de la batalla; no lo volverás a hacer.
es.B: Ponle la mano encima, \q y te acordarás de la lucha y nunca más lo harás.
es.R: Tócalo una sola vez, \q y te acordarás de la pelea y nunca más lo intentarás.

fr.L: Pose ta main sur lui ; \q souviens-toi du combat ; tu ne recommenceras pas.
fr.B: Pose seulement la main sur lui, \q et tu te souviendras du combat et ne recommenceras jamais.
fr.R: Touche-le une seule fois, \q et tu te souviendras de la bataille et tu n’essaieras plus jamais.

sw.L: Weka mikono yako juu yake; \q ukumbuke vita; hutarudia [tena].
sw.B: Weka tu mkono wako juu yake, \q nawe utakumbuka mapigano na hutarudia kamwe.
sw.R: Mguse mara moja tu, \q nawe utakumbuka mapigano na hutajaribu tena kamwe.

vi.L: Hãy đặt bàn tay ngươi trên nó; \q hãy nhớ trận chiến; ngươi sẽ chẳng làm [thế] nữa.
vi.B: Cứ thử đặt tay lên nó, \q rồi ngươi sẽ nhớ trận giao tranh và chẳng bao giờ làm lại nữa.
vi.R: Chỉ cần chạm vào nó một lần, \q ngươi sẽ nhớ trận đánh ấy và không bao giờ dám thử lại.

ko.L: 네 손을 그것 위에 얹어 보아라. \q 그 싸움을 기억하라. 다시는 [그렇게] 하지 못할 것이다.
ko.B: 그것에게 손을 한번 대 보아라. \q 그 싸움을 잊지 못하고 다시는 그러지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 그것을 한 번만 건드려 보아라. \q 그 싸움을 기억하고 다시는 해 볼 생각도 못 할 것이다.

pt.L: Põe a tua mão sobre ele; \q lembra-te da batalha; não [o] farás de novo.
pt.B: Basta pôr a mão nele, \q e te lembrarás da luta e nunca mais farás isso.
pt.R: Toca nele uma vez só, \q e te lembrarás da luta e nunca mais vais tentar isso.

decisions.choice: do not do it again: you will never try it again
decisions.reason: The last words can be a command ("do not do it again") or a statement of what will happen ("you will not do it again"). Either way the point is that one fight with Leviathan is enough for anyone.

decisions.choice: put your palms on it: lay a hand on it, attack it
decisions.reason: To lay a hand on someone is to attack or seize them (1 Samuel 24:7). Try it once, and you will never forget the fight.

decisions.choice: the description goes on in chapter 41
decisions.reason: The speech about Leviathan continues in 41:1-26 (41:9-34 in many Bibles).

decisions.choice: lay a hand on it, and you will remember ... and never
alternatives: Lay your hand on it; remember the battle; do not do it again
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable join the three short commands into one sentence of cause and result, as m1 reads them.
